page_title: LEN 1-0 CLE | Lens v Clermont 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' What an excellent shot, but not the luckiest one. Florian Sotoca (Lens) fires the ball from inside the penalty box but it only hits the left post!
89' Substitution. Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) in, Elye Wahi out.
86' Pascal Gastien prepares a substitution. Muhammed Cham is replaced by Bilal Boutobba (Clermont).
85' Nampalys Mendy (Lens) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
85' Deiver Machado comes off the pitch to be replaced by Massadio Haidara (Lens).

81' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the bottom left corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Brice Samba, who gets down to save.
79' A yellow card for a tackle by Yohan Magnin (Clermont). Benoit Bastien doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
77' Here is a change. Angelo Fulgini is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to David Pereira da Costa (Lens).
77' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
74' Benoit Bastien blows for a foul after Florian Sotoca (Lens) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
73' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
71' Elye Wahi (Lens) dribbles into the box, but Mory Diaw is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
69' Benoit Bastien blows the whistle, Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is penalised for a foul.
67' Poor challenge! Nampalys Mendy (Lens) is penalised for tripping and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle.
66' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
65' What a wasted opportunity by Elye Wahi (Lens)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Mory Diaw makes a decent save to thwart him.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) for Alan Virginius.
63' The goal by Lens is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
63' The Lens players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Bastien makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
62' Pascal Gastien has decided to substitute Habib Keita and he is replaced by Jeremie Bela (Clermont).
61' Facundo Medina (Lens) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 2:0.
61' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
60' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
60' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
59' The ball is cleared after Angelo Fulgini (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman makes the right call and Lens will have a corner.
55' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Muhammed Cham (Clermont), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
54' A free kick has been awarded to Clermont.
54' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Deiver Machado (Lens) for a tough tackle.
53' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Mory Diaw easily deals with the threat.
51' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Bastien saw the whole situation.

49' What a chance that is! Yohan Magnin (Clermont) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
47' Kevin Danso (Lens) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
46' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

46' Elye Wahi (Lens) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Mory Diaw inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save. Corner kick. Lens will have an opportunity.
46' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Benoit Bastien shows the yellow card to Habib Keita (Clermont) for a heavy challenge.

44' Facundo Medina (Lens) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Clermont are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
42' Nampalys Mendy (Lens) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
40' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Benoit Bastien pulls out a yellow card.
39' A corner kick by Clermont is thwarted by the well prepared Brice Samba (Lens).
39' Clermont have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Clermont have a corner.
38' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Now Clermont have a corner.
38' OFF THE POST! Florian Sotoca (Lens) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post! The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
37' Elye Wahi (Lens) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
36' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
35' Neto Borges (Clermont) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul. Lens are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
34' The game is interrupted as Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is flagged offside.
33' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
33' A lofted cross from Florian Sotoca (Lens) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
32' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and it's Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
30' Facundo Medina (Lens) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for an infringement.
29' Elye Wahi (Lens) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
28' A clumsy foul by Deiver Machado (Lens) and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle.
26' Elye Wahi (Lens) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
25' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
23' Alan Virginius (Clermont) brings his opponent down. Benoit Bastien has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.

20' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) tests the keeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. His decent effort goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
19' Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lens.
19' Johan Gastien (Clermont) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Benoit Bastien didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
16' Elye Wahi (Lens) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
14' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle after Johan Gastien (Clermont) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
12' Florian Sotoca (Lens) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
10' Rough tackle by Deiver Machado (Lens). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Yohan Magnin (Clermont) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
9' Florian Sotoca (Lens) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Benoit Bastien blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
9' Clermont can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

8' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Clermont will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Florian Sotoca (Lens) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mory Diaw into the bottom right corner.
2' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

1' Chrislain Matsima (Clermont) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Lens!
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Lens will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text coverage. We will try to provide you with a detailed image of what's happening on the pitch. There are only few moments left to the beginning of the match.
